verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI's own docs describe official Python and TypeScript SDKs. They cover transcription, streaming and voice agents. The SDK handles upload, submit and polling in a single call, manages the WebSocket session for streaming, and comes with SDK-specific context for coding agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs in use; evidence covers only two SDK languages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use the Python or TypeScript SDK to integrate transcription, streaming, and voice agents directly into your own codebase.
The SDK uploads, submits, and polls for you in a single call.
The AssemblyAI SDK manages the WebSocket connection and session termination for you.
You want curated SDK-specific context (Python / JS / streaming / voice agents) bundled with the agent, auto-loaded when relevant.
